items.title: Show Proof-or-stop on playback and exported video frames
items.context: Update the DOM playback heading and shared canvas export chrome; verify visible branding and retained story context.
items.userSees: Proof-or-stop in the playback/export header and every exported frame, alongside the story identity.

happy.desc: Opening timeline playback and completing its initialization both show the exact product name Proof-or-stop alongside the current story identifier and playback context.

edge.desc: Representative light and dark export frames at the supported MP4 and GIF dimensions display Proof-or-stop clearly while retaining the story identifier and timeline context without title overlap or clipping.

adversarial.desc: Advancing playback and rendering a later export frame retain the branding; heading refreshes must not replace it with an unbranded title, and existing story metadata remains legible.

verificationEvidence.note: CUA browser on localhost:8738 running this worktree build showed Proof-or-stop · B-fe8f · timeline playback after opening and completing initialization; screenshot inspected at 1280x720. Actual MP4 export completed.
verificationEvidence.nonMechanicalReason: Verification was performed through the CUA browser tool; this host browser session has no executable-plus-argv replay command for CLI-owned execution. This is a manual browser attestation, not mechanical coverage.

verificationEvidence.note: Actual browser exports inspected: light MP4 1920x1080 at /Users/qipan/Downloads/B-fe8f-timeline-2026-09-07-02-22-30.mp4 (12s frame /private/tmp/proof-or-stop-brand-frame.png), dark GIF 1440x810 at /Users/qipan/Downloads/B-fe8f-timeline-2026-09-07-02-23-41.gif (18s frame /private/tmp/proof-or-stop-brand-dark.png). Both show Proof-or-stop · Story Graph and B-fe8f timeline separated without overlap or clipping.
verificationEvidence.nonMechanicalReason: Actual CUA browser export and visual frame inspection cannot be replayed by an executable-plus-argv command through this CLI. Manual visual attestation only; no mechanical coverage claimed.

verificationEvidence.note: CUA observed branded heading at transition 1 and transition 2 after initialization, playback progress, export reset and reopen. Later exported frames at MP4 12s and GIF 18s retain brand and B-fe8f timeline context.
verificationEvidence.nonMechanicalReason: CUA browser interactions and visual frame inspections were performed by the agent; no executable-plus-argv replay is available for this host session. Manual browser attestation, not mechanical coverage.
